Khua third-party notices
===============================

Khua builds the third-party software below from the source archives,
versions, and SHA-256 values recorded in ThirdParty/deps.lock.json. Every other
file in this directory is an unmodified copy of the named file from that locked
upstream archive (path relative to the archive's top-level directory).

FFmpeg 8.1.2 -- LGPL-2.1-or-later (configured without GPL, version3, or
nonfree components); statically linked into KhuaPlayerMediaCore
    FFmpeg/LICENSE.md             LICENSE.md
    FFmpeg/COPYING.LGPLv2.1    COPYING.LGPLv2.1
    FFmpeg/COPYING.LGPLv3          COPYING.LGPLv3 (additional upstream text)
    FFmpeg is built with the downstream patches listed under "ffmpeg" in
    ThirdParty/deps.lock.json (Scripts/patches/).

dav1d 1.5.1 -- BSD-2-Clause; Alliance for Open Media Patent License 1.0;
statically linked into KhuaPlayerMediaCore
    dav1d/COPYING              COPYING
    dav1d/PATENTS              doc/PATENTS

Speex 1.2.1 -- BSD-3-Clause (Xiph.Org); statically linked into
KhuaPlayerMediaCore
    Speex/COPYING              COPYING

libass 0.17.5 -- ISC; shipped as Frameworks/libass.9.dylib
    libass/COPYING             COPYING

The following libraries are statically linked into libass.9.dylib:

libpng 1.6.58 -- PNG Reference Library License version 2
    libpng/LICENSE             LICENSE

FreeType 2.14.3 -- FreeType License (FTL); the BDF and PCF drivers carry
their own X11-style notices
    FreeType/LICENSE.TXT           LICENSE.TXT
    FreeType/FTL.TXT               docs/FTL.TXT
    FreeType/GPLv2.TXT             docs/GPLv2.TXT (alternative upstream text)
    FreeType/bdf-README        src/bdf/README
    FreeType/pcf-README        src/pcf/README

FriBidi 1.0.16 -- LGPL-2.1-or-later
    FriBidi/COPYING            COPYING

libunibreak 7.0 -- zlib-style license
    libunibreak/LICENCE        LICENCE

Graphite2 1.3.15 -- LGPL-2.1-or-later, MPL-2.0, GPL-2.0-or-later, or MIT
(see both files)
    Graphite2/COPYING          COPYING
    Graphite2/LICENSE          LICENSE

HarfBuzz 14.3.0 -- "Old MIT" license; MIT for the Microsoft Universal
Shaping Engine data
    HarfBuzz/COPYING           COPYING
    HarfBuzz/ms-use-COPYING    src/ms-use/COPYING

Sparkle 2.9.6 -- MIT and the bundled third-party notices in its LICENSE;
the framework is embedded only in the direct-distribution build (removed from
App Store builds), while this notice set ships unchanged in every build
    Sparkle/LICENSE            LICENSE

Acknowledgments required by the licenses above
----------------------------------------------

This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.
(FFmpeg's libavcodec includes jrevdct.c, jfdctfst.c, and jfdctint_template.c;
see FFmpeg/LICENSE.md.)

This software is based in part on the work of the FreeType Team
(https://freetype.org).

Corresponding source
--------------------

The exact upstream source archives are identified by URL and SHA-256 in
ThirdParty/deps.lock.json. The complete build recipes (Scripts/build_*.sh) and
the downstream FFmpeg patches are part of the Khua source repository.
